resources.string: Keep your POS ready for the next sale.
Checking for a newer LiquorBee POS build.
Check for the latest available POS build.
LiquorBee POS was not found on this device. You can download the iMin app below.
A newer build is available. Finish any active sale, then download and install the update when you are ready.
Your installed build is current with the published version.
Update postponed for 24 hours. You can open the updater anytime.
Open update screen once a day
While a newer POS build is available, open this screen at most once every 24 hours. Later postpones it for 24 hours. Opens only when the device is awake and unlocked, when Android runs a check.
Automatic screen opening is paused. Update notifications can still be used when monitoring is on.

To open the update screen over the POS once a day, allow Display over other apps for LiquorBee Updater in Android settings. Without it, tap an update notification to review. Automatic opening may interrupt an active sale.
This device does not offer the required setting. Use update notifications to open the updater.
Checks about once an hour, even when this screen is closed, and resumes after a restart. Android may delay checks to save power.
Automatic checks are paused. You can still use Check now.
Android could not schedule background checks. Try turning automatic checks off and on again.
If you force-stop the updater in Android settings, open it again to resume checks.
Notifications are on. Tap an update alert to open this app.
Notifications are off. Enable them to hear about new POS builds while the updater is closed.
Open Android settings, select LiquorBee Updater, then enable notifications.
Downloads open in your browser. Android will guide you through installation. The updater checks the installed version again when you return.
Latest build: LiquorBee on GitHub\nDownload: LiquorBee POS portal · iMin
No browser is available to open the download. Install or enable a browser and try again.
